purpose: Fixed comparison contract for the A0-A6 accuracy program

comparator.version_policy: record the installed version; do not infer it from documentation

descriptor_contract.unsupported_policy: count in the full denominator and report by cause

retrieval_contract.tie_break: similarity descending, original input index ascending
retrieval_contract.excluded_rows: never silently remove; preserve original indices and typed status

acceptance.declared_compatibility_scope: zero strict mismatches and 100% coverage on the frozen scope
acceptance.independent_superiority: paired scaffold-cluster evaluation with predeclared endpoint and uncertainty
